title: CIS-SPM: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Strategic Portfolio Management
description: Practice 182 verified questions across all topics in CIS-SPM: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Strategic Portfolio Management.

questions.question: Which plugin must be installed to use the Time Sheet dashboard?

options.label: B
options.text: Common ITSM Service Portal Application Components (com.snc.app_common.service_portal)

options.label: D
options.text: Performance Analytics - Content Pack - PPM Standard plugin (com.snc.pa.pmo_dashboards)

questions.explanation:
The Time Sheet dashboard is provided through the Performance Analytics – Content Pack – PPM Standard plugin (`com.snc.pa.pmo_dashboards`). ServiceNow documents this plugin as the activation option for the PPM analytics content and lists **Time Sheets > Time Sheet Portal > Time Sheet Dashboard** as an access path.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Analytics and reporting](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/project-portfolio-content-pack.html?contentId=ZC3xvAfrfmohP6HLkaSVHQ)

questions.question: If a lens contains four entities, which entity in the lens structure would have no parent reference?
questions.explanation: The top-level entity is the root of the hierarchy and therefore has no parent reference. All lower-level entities reference a parent entity.

questions.question: Which ServiceNow application integrates with SPM by using customer projects?
questions.explanation:
Customer Service Management includes Customer Project Management, which integrates with Strategic Portfolio Management to automatically track customer order-fulfillment work as customer projects. [ServiceNow: Strategic Portfolio Management integration workflow](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/order-management/sales-and-order-management/spm-integration-workflow.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Strategic Portfolio Management integration workflow](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/order-management/sales-and-order-management/spm-integration-workflow.html)

questions.question: You can forecast a project's future costs based on which factors? (select 2)

options.label: B
options.text: Changes in project such as project requirements.

questions.explanation: Project cost forecasting relies on actual costs incurred to date and on expected changes to the project, including changes in project requirements, because both affect the projected total cost.

questions.question: Which artifacts can be created from a demand? (select 3)
questions.explanation: In ServiceNow Demand Management, a demand can generate a change, project, or defect as downstream work records. Resources are allocated to work, and tasks are not among these demand-created artifact types.

questions.question: Based on the execution type selected for a particular project, one of these dashboards will also be available:
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Project Workspace determines the Analytics dashboard from the project execution type. For a Waterfall project, it displays the Project Summary – Waterfall dashboard; the documented execution-type mappings use project-summary dashboards rather than the Timecard, User Manager, or PMO dashboards.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Project analytics widgets and reports](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/project-analytics-widgets.html)

questions.question: In which status is a resource assignment created when the assignment is for a user or group?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Project Workspace, a resource assignment for a user or group is created with a resource status of **Pending**. Attribute-based resource assignments are created as **Unassigned** instead.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Resource assignment form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/pw-resource-assignment-form.html)

questions.question: At what point in the Demand Management lifecycle are assessments sent to stakeholders?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Demand Management, moving a submitted demand to the Screening state initiates stakeholder assessments; the demand manager can then send assessment surveys to stakeholders. [Use Demand Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/r_UsingDemandManagement.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Use Demand Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/r_UsingDemandManagement.html)

questions.question: Users with which role are considered for resource planning?
questions.explanation:
Only users assigned the PPS Resource (`pps_resource`) role are considered for resource planning and can appear in resource plans.

**Learn more:** [Roles installed with PPM Standard (Project Portfolio Management)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/yokohama-it-business-management/page/product/project-portfolio-suite-with-financials/reference/roles-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: An it_project_manager can request resources using which of the following? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Resource Management lets project managers request resources through resource plans using request types including Hours and Person Days. Month and Day describe time periods or allocation views, not resource-request types.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/c_ResourcePlans.html) · [ServiceNow Resource assignment form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/pw-resource-assignment-form.html)

questions.question: Is resource capacity derived from FTEs or schedules?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Resource Management, total resource capacity is derived from the user or group schedule, with group capacity rolled up from members’ schedules. Capacity is not derived from FTE values.

**Learn more:** [Review capacity of the resources](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/resource-management/review-capacity-for-resources.html?contentId=fOsYdcBo4MRcu_4pxUrPTQ)

questions.question: A program serves as a container for all of the following except:
questions.explanation: A portfolio is a higher-level organizational entity that groups programs; it is not contained within a program. Program records can contain associated program tasks, issues, and cost plans.

questions.question: What must be filled in for a resource to be included in capacity planning?
questions.explanation:
Capacity planning evaluates resource capacity by the selected primary attribute, such as a resource group, role, or skill. A resource therefore needs a populated primary attribute value to be considered.

**Learn more:** [Use Capacity Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/using-cap-plan-pp.html)

questions.question: Which default project template configuration records are available in the Template Config module? (select 3)
questions.explanation: ServiceNow's project structure is organized hierarchically as Project, Project Task, and Project Subtask, and the Template Config module provides a default configuration record for each of these three levels so that new records created at that level automatically inherit a consistent set of default field values. This lets an implementer standardize how new projects, their tasks, and the subtasks beneath those tasks are populated when created, without needing to configure defaults separately for every individual project. Because the module's default configuration records map directly onto this three-level work breakdown structure, Project, Project Task, and Project Subtask are the record types with default Template Config entries.

questions.question: Which Now Create methodology stage contains Transition, Mobilize, Prepare, and Conduct?
questions.explanation: In the Now Create methodology, Transition is the stage that encompasses the Transition, Mobilize, Prepare, and Conduct activities.

questions.question: When recording time worked on a time sheet, which feature is recommended for grouping different kinds of work (for example, standard hours and overtime)?
questions.explanation:
Rate types categorize different kinds of work, including Standard versus Overtime. A rate type selected on a time card can also match the appropriate labor rate card for cost processing.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Rate type in labor rate card](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/cost-management/RateType.html) · [ServiceNow: Create a rate type](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/CreateRateType.html?contentId=GJqsqeOJOXBkCXhRICV3yA)

questions.question: Which of the following can be used to calculate planned cost while creating a resource plan? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
Planned cost is derived by multiplying planned hours by an applicable hourly rate. The hourly rate can come from the rate configuration associated with the project or from a rate card; ServiceNow documentation describes this project-associated source as a rate model and also supports labor rate cards for resource-plan cost calculations.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource Plan form tabs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-plan-form-tabs.html) · [ServiceNow Resource Allocation form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-allocation-form.html)

questions.question: The overall health of a program is determined by rolling up the most recent status report from each project within that program. Which colors are used to indicate this status? (select 3)
questions.explanation: Program and project health reporting commonly uses the RAG (Red-Amber/Yellow-Green) status model. Each project submits a status report indicating its health as Green (on track), Yellow (at risk/needs attention), or Red (critical issues/off track), and these individual project statuses roll up to determine the overall program health. Orange is not one of the standard status colors used in this model.

questions.question: What determines the resource schedule when both the **Schedules** related list and the **Schedule** field are empty?

options.label: D
options.text: Average Daily FTE Hours/Hours Per Person Day (com.snc.resource_management.average_daily_fte) property

questions.explanation: When no schedule is supplied through either the Schedules related list or the Schedule field, ServiceNow Resource Management uses the instance default configured by the **Default Schedule Name** (`com.snc.resource_management.default_schedule`) property. The other properties govern effort or FTE-hour calculations, or a separate project-management default, rather than this fallback schedule selection.

questions.question: On a resource plan, when the **Derive assignee list from resource plan** attribute is set to true, which state must the plan be in before a resource can be added to the assignee field?
questions.explanation:
An assignee list derived from a resource plan is limited to resources allocated through that plan. The Allocated state represents completed resource allocation and converts soft allocations to hard allocations, making the allocated resource eligible for assignment.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/c_ResourcePlans.html)

questions.question: What is the formula used to calculate Committed Utilization?
questions.explanation: Committed utilization measures the combined allocated and confirmed hours as a proportion of capacity: (Allocated Hours + Confirmed Hours) / Capacity.

questions.question: The Idea [im_idea_core] table directly extends which table?

options.label: D
options.text: It is not extended from any table

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow documents the Idea [im_idea_core] table as the default table for Idea Portal information and specifies that it extends the Task table.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Product Documentation — Innovation management tables](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/xanadu-it-business-management/page/product/project-portfolio-suite-with-financials/reference/table-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: Which roles are able to create rate models? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow requires either the `pps_admin` role or the `it_rate_model_admin` role to create or modify a rate model. The rate model administrator role has full rate-model management privileges, and the PPS administrator role includes that capability.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create or modify a rate model](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/rate-model/create-rate-model.html) · [ServiceNow: Roles installed with PPM Standard](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/roles-installed-with-PPS-finance.html?contentId=68jliB9w8VfWwamqpHRXMQ)

questions.question: What are the basic functions of Demand Management? (select 2)

options.label: B
options.text: Use the Project Workspace to compare and assess demands

questions.explanation:
Demand Management supports promoting a qualified demand to a project, enhancement, change, or defect. It also supports creating and associating stakeholder records with a demand so stakeholders can provide requirements and assessments. Demand comparison and assessment is performed in the Demand Management workbench rather than Project Workspace; ideas originate through Idea Portal or catalog intake before evaluation.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Assess demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_AssessingDemands.html) · [ServiceNow: Add details to demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_EnhancingDemands.html)

questions.question: Who is permitted to submit Ideas?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow's Idea Management feature is intentionally designed to allow open participation from the entire user base — any user of the platform can submit an idea through the Idea Portal, regardless of whether they hold a specialized role such as ITIL, demand, or IT-specific access. Role-based restrictions apply later in the idea lifecycle (for review, evaluation, and conversion into demands or projects), but the submission step itself is open to any user so that innovation and improvement suggestions can come from anyone in the organization.

**Learn more:** [Submit an idea - ServiceNow Docs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/submit-idea-in-idea-portal.html) · [Idea Management in ServiceNow SPM – Roles, Lifecycle, Portal Usage, and Governance Overview](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/idea-management-in-servicenow-spm-roles-lifecycle-portal-usage/m-p/3508017)

questions.question: What is a project's default schedule?
questions.explanation: The default Standard calendar defines an 8-hour workday: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

questions.question: How can cost plans be created from resource assignments? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Select the ‘Generate labor costs’ button on Project Workspace

options.label: B
options.text: Update the appropriate Resource Management property

options.label: C
options.text: Run a scheduled job to automatically generate labor costs from resource assignments

options.label: D
options.text: Select the ‘Generate cost’ button in Resource Management Workspace

questions.explanation:
For finalized resource assignments, ServiceNow can create attribute-based labor cost plans by selecting **Generate labor costs** in Project Workspace. It can also generate them automatically at a defined cadence by activating the scheduled job for labor costs for projects and demands.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Generate labor costs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/gen-labor-costs-prj-wrkspc.html) · [ServiceNow: Activate a scheduled job to generate labor costs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/project-management/gen-labor-costs-scheduled-job-ppm.html)

questions.question: Which property governs changes to cost and resource plans when the start date of a demand or project is changed?

options.label: A
options.text: ‘Change Resource Plan, Cost Plan and Benefit Plan Start Date with Demand or Project Start Date Change’.

options.label: B
options.text: ‘Enable altering of planned date for task in WIP/Closed’.

options.label: D
options.text: ‘Calculate ROI percentage based on a project's estimated cost and its net value’.

questions.explanation:
The `com.snc.project.date_change_cascade` property updates the start dates of associated resource plans, cost plans, and benefit plans when a project or demand start date changes. Benefit-plan dates change only when the plan’s offset type is not `None`.

**Learn more:** [Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html?contentId=i_qkbX4vfkGHJJTJ9nEHag)

questions.question: Which of the following items should implementers create or configure first during an SPM implementation?
questions.explanation:
Business units provide the organizational foundation for Strategic Portfolio Management. The predefined Organization lens uses Company, Business Unit, and Department as planning levels, so this hierarchy must exist before configuring planning lenses and the processes or reporting built around them.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Lenses in Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/lens-and-portfolio-plans.html) · [ServiceNow: Strategic Portfolio Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/xanadu-it-business-management/page/product/it-business-management/reference/r_ITBusinessManagement.html)

questions.question: What does a resource event refer to?

options.label: B
options.text: A block of time that a resource spends on a task.

options.label: D
options.text: An event scheduled by a project manager.

questions.explanation: A resource event is a non-scheduled activity that affects a resource’s available capacity.

questions.question: At which level is the project property for updating actual effort from a time card controlled?
questions.explanation:
The **Update actual effort from time card** setting is a Project form preference. It determines whether hours entered on time cards update the Actual effort field and roll up to the project and project tasks.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Project form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/it-business-management/project-management/create-a-project-form.html?contentId=YILYr0L2y9j15DQaR4wMVw)

questions.question: Which information must users enter for a demand cost plan?
questions.explanation:
A demand cost plan requires a cost type to define the kind of planned expense. Functional currency is system-derived, while total planned cost is calculated from the plan’s cost inputs. [ServiceNow: Create a demand cost plan](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_CreateADemandCostPlan.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a demand cost plan](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_CreateADemandCostPlan.html) · [ServiceNow: Cost Plan form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/cost-plan-form-project-management.html)

questions.question: Which role must a group have to be selected in a resource assignment?
questions.explanation:
A group must have the `pps_resource` role for group-based resource assignment. This role makes the group eligible for selection as a resource assignment.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create resource assignments for groups](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/create-group-resource-assignment.html)

questions.question: If an it_project_manager does not want hours to be distributed equally across the resource plan time frame, which allocation spread should be used?
questions.explanation:
Front Load allocates hours into available resource slots starting from the allocation’s start date, rather than splitting the hours evenly across the working days. ServiceNow documents Even and Front Load as the allocation-spread options; Even is the equal-distribution option.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource Plan form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-plan-form.html) · [ServiceNow Resource allocation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/r_AllocatingResources.html)

questions.question: What occurs to the expense line once it has been processed?

options.label: C
options.text: The actual cost is recorded at the portfolio level

questions.explanation:
A processed expense line contributes its incurred amount to the associated cost plan as an actual cost. ServiceNow documentation also states that an expense line must be processed to be considered for actual cost.

**Learn more:** [Create an expense line](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAExpenseLine.html) · [View actual project costs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_ViewActualProjectCosts.html)

questions.question: Which default table stores the idea categories a user can choose from when submitting an idea?
questions.explanation:
For static idea categories, ServiceNow Innovation Management uses the default Idea Category table, `im_category`. Its records supply the category options available to users submitting an idea.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Idea Category Configuration form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-category-configurations-form.html?contentId=CA3IOgygCDFH0QWUUuOM3Q)

questions.question: When requesting resources from a group and a resource role is specified, from where is planned cost calculated?

options.label: C
options.text: The hourly rate of the specified role.

questions.explanation:
For a group resource request with a specified resource role, planned cost is calculated using the hourly rate of that specified role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Resource Plan form tabs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-plan-form-tabs.html?contentId=rWlH0aMu5jAq0duQvBeu9Q)

questions.question: What does red signify on the Allocation heatmap?
questions.explanation:
Red denotes that a resource is overallocated, meaning its assigned work exceeds its available capacity. Smartsheet’s workload heatmap documentation identifies red as “Over allocated.”

**Learn more:** [Workload tracking in Smartsheet](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483101-workload-tracking-in-smartsheet)

questions.question: Demand assessments are triggered as soon as a demand enters which state?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Demand Management, new assessments are triggered when a demand moves to the **Screening** state, provided that the demand’s **Assessment Required** field is set to true.

**Learn more:** [Reset a demand to Draft state](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/reset-demand-to-draft-state.html)

questions.question: When a source project is copied to a target project, which fields are copied by default? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
By default, ServiceNow copies the short description, planned dates, and duration fields from the source project to the target project. State is set to New rather than copied, and Number is not one of the default copied fields.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Copy a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/project-management/t_CopyAProject.html)

questions.question: In the context of managing demands, which field needs to be set to "Yes" so that a user will receive an assessment?
questions.explanation:
On a demand's stakeholder record, the Assessment Recipient field determines whether that stakeholder is sent an assessment questionnaire. When Assessment Recipient is set to Yes for a stakeholder on a given demand, that user will receive a request to complete the demand's assessment metrics (such as risk and strategic alignment) during the assessment/screening phase. The Level of Interest and Influence fields are used to characterize a stakeholder's engagement and power for stakeholder management purposes, and the Approver field designates authority to approve the demand — none of these triggers assessment delivery.

**Learn more:** [Demand stakeholder assessment recipients question - ServiceNow Community](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/demand-stakeholder-assessment-recipients-question/m-p/1018908) · [How to Delegate a Demand Assessment - ServiceNow Community](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/how-to-delegate-a-demand-assessment/m-p/1012902)

questions.question: Which option describes the default schedule for the Project Management application?

options.label: A
options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday. Includes the child schedule U.S. Holidays.

options.label: B
options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm.

options.label: C
options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 9:00am to 5:00pm.

options.label: D
options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday.

questions.explanation:
The Project Management Schedule is the default schedule for the Project Management application. It runs every weekday, Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to noon and from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. [ServiceNow Default schedules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/time-configuration/r_DefaultSchedules.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Default schedules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/time-configuration/r_DefaultSchedules.html) · [ServiceNow Get started with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/project-management/project-management-intro.html)

questions.question: Plugins can be added to the base platform through one of the following methods. (select 3)

options.label: C
options.text: Activated by default in the base ServiceNow system.

options.label: E
options.text: Activated by an admin (not by default).

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow plugins become available on an instance in three ways: they are activated by default as part of the base system, they are activated manually by a user with the admin role (not activated by default), or they must be requested from ServiceNow (typically for plugins with special licensing or deployment restrictions, requiring ServiceNow personnel to activate them). There is no standard 'it_pps_admin' or 'it_portfolio_manager' role involved in plugin activation.

**Learn more:** [How to request, activate, and purchase plugins - Now Support Portal](https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0695388) · [Plugin frequently asked questions for ServiceNow instances - Now Support Portal](https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0716626)

questions.question: When may a user select from multiple rate types for their work while recording a time card?

options.label: A
options.text: Only if this capability is enabled in the Project Record

options.label: B
options.text: Only one (1) rate type can apply

options.label: C
options.text: Only if the capability is enabled in the Time Sheet Policies

options.label: D
options.text: Only if the capability is enabled in the Project Preferences

questions.explanation:
The **Allow multiple rate types** setting in the user’s assigned Time Sheet Policy displays the Rate type field on the Time Card form, allowing selection among rate types.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a time card](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/time-card-management/t_CreateATimeCard.html)

questions.question: Where can an administrator set the colors and quadrant labels in the Demand Workbench?
questions.explanation:
Demand Workbench display settings, including bubble-chart configuration such as colors and quadrant labels, are maintained on the Demand Workbench record under **Workbench Config - Demand**. ServiceNow documents this location as Project Administration > Settings > Workbench Config - Demand.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure demand workbench](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_CreatingBubbleCharts.html)

questions.question: When a sub-project and its parent project use different project currencies, this property must be set to true for cost rollups.
questions.explanation:
The `com.snc.project.multicurrency.rollup_if_different` property enables financial rollups when a sub-project and its parent project have different project currencies. When enabled, sub-project amounts are converted to the parent project's currency for the rollup.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Cost rollup in project currency](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/project-costing-project-currency.html)

questions.question: What can be created for a group to schedule required meetings, training, time off, etc., and reflect reduced capacity on the Capacity Planning tab in the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation:
An operational resource assignment allocates part of a team’s capacity to operational work, including meetings, training, and time off. These assignments are accounted for in Capacity Planning and reduce the capacity available for portfolio work.

**Learn more:** [Use Capacity Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/using-cap-plan-pp.html) · [Create operational resource assignments](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/create-op-rsrc-asgnmnts-ppm.html)

questions.question: Which colors serve as project-health indicators in a project status report? (select 3)
questions.explanation: Project status reports commonly use red, yellow, and green indicators to communicate health: green for on track, yellow for caution or risk, and red for a significant issue or off-track condition.

questions.question: Which plugin must be installed to use Capacity Planning in a portfolio?
questions.explanation:
Capacity Planning is a Portfolio Planning capability that provides portfolio-level visibility into resource capacity, allocations, and utilization. It requires the Portfolio Planning application/plugin.

**Learn more:** [Capacity planning in Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/capacity-planning-pp.html)

questions.question: When a project is created from a demand, which related records are moved and copied during Project Creation?
questions.explanation:
Demand-to-project conversion transfers the demand’s resource plans and cost plans to the created project. Assessment-related values may be copied as fields, but assessment records are not transferred as the relevant related-record pair.

**Learn more:** [Demand to project conversion](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/demand-to-project-conversion/ta-p/2300270)

questions.question: Which feature enables users to create scenarios in a simulated environment and modify the prioritization and timelines of planning items?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Scenario Planning provides a simulated, non-live version of a plan in which planning items can be prioritized or deprioritized and their timelines adjusted. [ServiceNow: Scenario planning in Strategic Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/scenario-planning-in-spw/scenario-planning-in-strategic-planning.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Scenario planning in Strategic Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/scenario-planning-in-spw/scenario-planning-in-strategic-planning.html)

questions.question: What can you create to change the display limit for roadmap items shown in the Roadmap view of the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation:
A system property controls the display-limit setting for Roadmap items in Portfolio Planning. Creating the appropriate property and setting it to the desired integer value overrides the default limit.

**Learn more:** [Update the display limit of items for Prioritization and Roadmap in Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/update-items-display-limit-backlog-prioritization-roadmap.html)

questions.question: In Project Workspace, how can users view data on the Financials tab? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
Project Workspace financials use fiscal-year data and support a quarterly view. ServiceNow documentation describes the Financials overview as displaying data for the selected fiscal year, with quarterly breakdown as the default, and identifies Year, Quarter, and Month as available financial-plan formats.

**Learn more:** [View forecasts and manage financial plans for a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/view-plan-financials-in-project-workspace.html)

questions.question: In which table is cost information for a particular fiscal period found?
questions.explanation:
The `cost_plan_breakdown` table contains cost breakdown records for individual fiscal periods, including estimated and actual cost values.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Cost plan breakdown form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/cost-plan-breakdown-form.html?contentId=L6NY0ZOmJo4r9BEV~OV5kg)

questions.question: Which role has the ability to create a project status report within the Project Workspace application?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, the Project Workspace application restricts creation of new project status reports to users holding the it_project_manager role. This role owns the project and is responsible for authoring and maintaining status reports; other roles like it_project_user, it_demand_manager, and itil do not have out-of-the-box access to create status reports in Project Workspace, even though related UI elements may be visible to them.

**Learn more:** [Create a status report in Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/yokohama-it-business-management/page/product/project-workspace/task/create-a-status-report-in-project-workspace.html) · [Project Workspace — Managing your Projects in ServiceNow](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/project-workspace-managing-your-projects-in-servicenow/ta-p/3501084)

questions.question: Why is it recommended that the value of the `com.snc.project.task.max_task_duration` property remain at 2600 or lower?

options.label: B
options.text: Best practices states projects should be no longer than 5 years.

options.label: C
options.text: Because projects longer than 2600 days will no longer load.

options.label: D
options.text: The system is unable to handle more than 2600 tasks.

questions.explanation:
Increasing `com.snc.project.task.max_task_duration` above 2600 affects ServiceNow platform memory usage; very high values can result in out-of-memory errors.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-it-business-management/page/product/project-management/reference/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html)

questions.question: To configure a group for selection in a resource plan, which role must the group record include?
questions.explanation:
Only users or groups with the ServiceNow PPS Resource (`pps_resource`) role are considered for resource planning and appear in resource plans. [ServiceNow: User resources and group resources](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/r_UserResourcesAndGroupResources.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — User resources and group resources](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/r_UserResourcesAndGroupResources.html)

questions.question: A project expense line is a cost associated with a specific source, except for:
questions.explanation:
A project expense line records a cost against a source record that generated or incurred the cost, such as a resource, fixed asset, or software/configuration item. A program groups or governs projects and is not itself the cost source for an expense line.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create an expense line](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAExpenseLine.html)

questions.question: Which table stores the daily capacity of a user?
questions.explanation: $ac

questions.question: Which default project-template configuration records are available in the Template Config module? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
The default Project Template Configuration items are the project object, the project task object, and the project subtask object. The project is the root-level object; project tasks are its children, and project subtasks are children of project tasks.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Project template configuration](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/c_ProjectTemplateConfiguration.html)

questions.question: Which ServiceNow application integrates with SPM by means of risk assessments?
questions.explanation:
Governance, Risk, and Compliance integrates with Project Portfolio Management within Strategic Portfolio Management to support project risk assessment, including assessing project risks and rolling up risk scores across projects, programs, and portfolios.

**Learn more:** [Project Risk Assessment using Advanced Risk Assessment](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/governance-risk-compliance/grc-risk-management-workspace/risk-and-ppm-better-together.html)

questions.question: Which system role is required to manage programs?
questions.explanation:
The `it_program_manager` role is required for program management in ServiceNow; it grants access to manage programs and their associated projects and demands.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Program Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

questions.question: If you want the project planned start date to stay unchanged regardless of the earliest task’s start date, which property would you disable?

options.label: A
options.text: Roll up project start date from tasks [com.snc.project.rollup_prroject_start_date],

options.label: B
options.text: Retain start on constraint on tasks after adding relations [com.snc.project.allow_start_on_relations].

options.label: C
options.text: Max duration allowed for a project/project task [com.snc.project.task.max_task_duration].

options.label: D
options.text: Max date span into future or past from the current date for the project/project task [com.snc.project.task.check_date_span_years].

questions.explanation:
The **Roll up project start date from tasks** property controls whether a project’s planned start date is derived from the planned start date of its earliest task. Disabling it keeps the project planned start date unchanged.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html)

questions.question: What is a saved data copy of the current project's tasks, schedule, or structure that can be used for later comparison reporting?
questions.explanation: A baseline preserves a snapshot of planned project data so that later progress, costs, dates, or structural changes can be compared with the original plan for reporting.

questions.question: Which users can access the Project Administration module? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
The Project Administration module contains Project Portfolio Suite configuration and administration functions that require the `it_pps_admin` role. A user with the `admin` role also has administrative access to these functions.

**Learn more:** [Populate the stakeholder registry](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_PopulatingTheStakeholderRegistry.html) · [Modify a project template configuration item](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_ModifAProjectTempConfigItem.html)

questions.question: Which of the following tasks can be carried out when Innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Create a project from a universal request

options.label: B
options.text: Create an idea from a universal request

options.label: C
options.text: Transfer an idea to another department

options.label: D
options.text: Send a universal request to a demand manager for review

questions.explanation:
Innovation Management integration with Universal Request lets employees or agents create an idea from a universal request. It also allows a routing agent to transfer an idea to another department, with or without resolution. [ServiceNow documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/universal-req-idea-mgmt.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Integrating Innovation Management with Universal Request](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/universal-req-idea-mgmt.html)

questions.question: Which personas may request an attribute-based resource assignment? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
Attribute-based resource assignments support resource requests for demands, projects, and project tasks. Demand managers request resources for demands, while project managers create resource assignments for projects and project tasks.

**Learn more:** [Create resource assignments using Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/create-ra-pws-rmw.html) · [Add details to demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_EnhancingDemands.html)

questions.question: Which role is able to configure the parameters of the Demand Workbench provided with the base system?
questions.explanation:
The `it_pps_admin` role administers Strategic Portfolio Management configuration, including Demand Workbench settings and parameters. Project-manager and business-stakeholder roles do not have that administrative configuration authority.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Community: PPM role guidance](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/best-practices-implementing-project-portfolio-management/m-p/2720360)

questions.question: Which system property must be set to **True** to allocate budgets in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation:
Financial budget allocation in Project Workspace is enabled by setting the `sn_invst_pln.enable_budget_allocation_v2` system property to `True`.

**Learn more:** [Enable financial budget allocation for projects in Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/enable-fin-budget-pws.html)

questions.question: What is the Demand Workbench used for? (select 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Comparing and prioritizing demands against other demands

questions.explanation:
The Demand Workbench supports assessing and approving demands and uses an interactive bubble chart to compare demand records by risk, value, and size, enabling their relative prioritization. Portfolio-level comparison and planning are handled through the separate Portfolio Planning Workbench.

**Learn more:** [Assess demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_AssessingDemands.html) · [Demand workbench bubble chart](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/demand-management/c_DemandWorkbenchBubbleChart.html?contentId=ev1Ir7Wvq16C1pfMBR1eKw)

questions.question: Which plugin enables the Ideas module to efficiently collect and evaluate ideas, and rapidly identify ideas for implementation?
questions.explanation:
The Ideation with PPM plugin, `com.snc.ppm_innovation_management`, supports collecting and collaborating on new ideas and identifying suitable ideas for implementation; selected ideas can be converted into demands, stories, projects, or epics.

**Learn more:** [Plugins installed with PPM Standard (Project Portfolio Management)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/plugins-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: With Scenario Planning for PPM installed, where can a portfolio manager navigate to access the Portfolio Planning Workbench? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
Scenario Planning for PPM provides access to Portfolio Planning Workbench through the Portfolio Planning Workbench module in the application navigator and through the Portfolio Planning related link on a portfolio record.

**Learn more:** [Create planning scenarios](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-management/create-scenarios.html?contentId=QtPsAwzJZAigQ7vrdFxHQw) · [Scenario Planning for PPM](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/fr-FR/it-business-management/portfolio-management/portfolio-planning-overview.html?contentId=lsRS3aEL23NBp_nkGF2Ypw)

questions.question: In the default system, when working with demands, which two assessment metrics are supported when completing an assessment survey? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
Risk and Strategic Alignment are the default Demand assessment metrics populated through assessment-category results collected from an assessment survey. Size and Cost instead use fields on the Demand record, rather than survey responses.

**Learn more:** [View an assessment metric category](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_CreateAnAssessmentCategory.html)

questions.question: To map custom fields from Microsoft Project to ServiceNow during a project import, you must first:

options.label: A
options.text: Export the project to XML format

options.label: B
options.text: Create custom fields in your ServiceNow instance

questions.explanation:
Custom fields must be created in the ServiceNow instance before they can be mapped to the corresponding Microsoft Project custom fields for project import.

**Learn more:** [Create custom field mapping for Microsoft Project file import](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/map-custom-fields-msp-project.html)

questions.question: Which role is needed to configure the default columns on the Planning page in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation:
The PPS admin role, `it_pps_admin`, is authorized to modify Project Portfolio Suite preferences, configurations, and settings. Default Planning-page columns are a configuration setting.

**Learn more:** [Roles installed with PPM Standard (Project Portfolio Management)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/roles-installed-with-PPS-finance.html) · [Add a custom column to the planning console](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/add-display-column.html)

questions.question: Which role should be assigned to a user to allow them to read and retrieve data from any table in the Release Management application for generating reports?
questions.explanation:
The Business Stakeholder role (`sn_release_read`) provides read access to Release Management tables and is intended for users who need to retrieve application data for reporting.

**Learn more:** [Business stakeholder role for Release Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-service-management/release-management/business-stakeholder-role-for-release-management.html?contentId=nSURRNMUPbz7sp3_mKLbHw)

questions.question: Demand managers can improve a demand request by adding the following: (select 3)
questions.explanation:
Demand requests can be enriched with stakeholder records to identify involved parties, requirement records to capture fulfillment needs, and decision records to document governance outcomes. Expense lines track demand-evaluation costs, while tasks are used to plan and delegate demand work.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Demand Management process flow](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/r_DemandManagementProcessFlow.html) · [ServiceNow: Add details to demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_EnhancingDemands.html)

questions.question: Where are the ‘Roles’ requested through resource plans defined?

options.label: D
options.text: No need to define it differently, they are same as system roles.

questions.explanation:
Roles used for resource planning are resource roles: job titles or skills that can be planned and later staffed with specific resources. They are maintained in the resource management area, not as system-security roles.

**Learn more:** [Oracle Primavera P6 Help — Assigning a Resource to a Role](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/G48897_01/p6help/en/34583.htm) · [Oracle Primavera P6 Help — About Resource Planning](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/G48897_01/p6help/en/100875.htm)

questions.question: What is the process of allocating a resource or group of resources to a project task called?
questions.explanation: Resource assignment is the act of allocating specific people, equipment, or other resources to a particular project task.

questions.question: After a time card is approved, in which two tables is the actual time stored? (select 2)

options.label: D
options.text: Resource Aggregate tables (Daily, Weekly and Monthly)

questions.explanation:
The Resource Allocation Daily table stores actual hours spent by a user on a task, project, or other activity. Resource Aggregate Daily, Weekly, and Monthly tables store aggregated actual-hours values, with weekly and monthly aggregates updated from Resource Allocation Daily changes.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Tables for PPM Standard](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/table-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: Which recommended feature can be used to modify the RIDAC workflow?
questions.explanation:
Flow Designer is ServiceNow’s recommended tool for building and modifying process automation flows; it is preferred over the legacy Workflow Editor for nearly all process-flow requirements.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Flow Designer documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/flow-designer.html?contentId=rZaEg_PjkgH~nzf8rXjB9g)

questions.question: When you create a planning item, which fields are automatically populated with the Approved start date value and the Approved end date value, respectively? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
For a newly created ServiceNow planning item, the Approved start date value populates **Planned start date**, and the Approved end date value populates **Planned end date**.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Portfolio Planning release notes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/delta-washingtondc-zurich/zurich-washingtondc-portfolioplanning-release-notes.html)

questions.question: On the demand form, what is affected by the Discount Rate?
questions.explanation: The discount rate determines how future cash flows are converted to present values, so it directly affects the Net Present Value (NPV).

questions.question: Which field in the Idea Module form shows the module’s unique identifier, used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL to direct users?
questions.explanation:
The Module ID is the Idea module’s unique identifier and is used as the `sysparm_module_id` parameter in the Idea Portal URL to identify the associated module.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Idea module form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-module-form.html?contentId=sicUIGGVIwMYPy5UJ9Uk2A) · [ServiceNow: Idea Portal navigation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-portal-navigation.html?contentId=nrMMkzMJTL93fTepwZ0siw)

questions.question: What must a resource plan include when it is associated with a time card?
questions.explanation:
A resource plan can be associated with a time card only when it contains hard allocations for the user. Hard allocations represent the committed resource allocation required for the time card association.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Associate a time card with a resource plan](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/t_AssocATimeCardWithAResourcePlan.html?contentId=lunDiWQSsh~6N2XNQYNR9Q)

questions.question: The PPM Standard plugin allows an `it_project_manager` to carry out the following activities: (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Track actual amount spent compared to an approved budget.

options.label: E
options.text: Establish resource requirements and track costs.

questions.explanation:
PPM Standard integrates Financial Management with Project Portfolio Management, enabling project and portfolio managers to determine overall cost requirements for demands and projects in portfolios, establish resource requirements and track their costs, and compare actual spending with an approved budget.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: PPM Standard (Project Portfolio Management)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/c_ProjectPortfolioSuiteWithFinancials.html?contentId=v_72xlajbwv~egGr28NSrg)

questions.question: Which formats can data be exported to from the Resource Management Workspace? (select 2)
questions.explanation: Resource Management Workspace exports tabular data as CSV files or Microsoft Excel workbooks. JPEG is an image format, and PowerPoint is not a supported data-export format for this workspace.

questions.question: What capabilities does the project status report provide to project managers? (select 2)

options.label: B
options.text: Show historical trend of project KPI's

questions.explanation:
Project status reports retain historical status entries and display trends for project KPIs, including overall health, schedule, cost, resources, and scope. They can also be printed from Project Workspace, including as a PDF output.

**Learn more:** [View project status reports](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/project-status-report.html) · [Create a project status report](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAProjectStatusReport.html)

questions.question: Where can a user export project data in the Excel, CSV, PPT, MS Project (MPP), or XML file formats?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Project Workspace provides an **Export project** action on a project's planning page, allowing project data to be exported as Excel, CSV, PPT, Microsoft Project (MPP), or XML files.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Export a project from Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/s8BPDWDEVTaN0SLuos4GTg/702121nJDRot9VlGfpqmiQ)

questions.question: A user's availability is determined as:

options.label: A
options.text: Allocated hours divided by the total capacity

options.label: C
options.text: Sum of allocated and confirmed hours, divided by the total capacity

questions.explanation: A user’s availability is the remaining capacity after allocated work is deducted; therefore, it equals capacity minus allocation.

questions.question: When configuring the `sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute` property, which options can be used to allocate budget by? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
The `sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute` property supports budget allocation by cost type or expense type. Cost types categorize financials such as hardware or labor, while expense types categorize them as Capex or Opex.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Define the budget attribute](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/config-budget-allocation-attribute-ppw.html?contentId=Pjec_Js8XBt6tSFnMHkjEg)

questions.question: Which status must a resource assignment have before it can be split?
questions.explanation:
Splitting a resource assignment creates a second assignment while both assignments retain the Approved state; therefore, the resource assignment must be approved.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Split resource assignments using Resource Management Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/split-resource-assignment-rmw.html)

questions.question: Which is the least-privileged role with access to the **Project Administration > Settings > Preferences-Project** module?
questions.explanation:
The `it_pps_admin` role grants administrative access to Project Management configuration properties managed through **Project Administration > Settings > Preferences - Project**. Project and program manager roles do not provide this settings-administration access, while `sys_admin` is broader than the minimum required role.

**Learn more:** [Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/project-management/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html?contentId=yD9t3rChDfWroS64JXjmcA)

questions.question: For a business unit to have its own Idea Portal for retrieving data, what must be configured first?

options.label: B
options.text: A business unit cannot have its own Idea Portal

questions.explanation:
An Idea module defines the ideas and categories displayed in an Idea Portal and can be created for a business unit. Its module ID is used to direct users through the Idea Portal URL; idea categories are configured or mapped afterward.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create an Idea module](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/create-idea-module.html) · [ServiceNow: Idea module form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-module-form.html)

questions.question: Each teamspace has its own: (select 2)
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow's Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM) module, activating the Teamspace plugin creates separate, prefixed copies of specific core tables — including Demand, Demand Task, Project, Project Task, Portfolio, and Program — for each teamspace, enabling business units to manage their own PPM data independently. Resource Plans (and other entities such as Cost Plans, Benefit Plans, Timecards, and organizational data) remain shared across all teamspaces rather than being duplicated per teamspace, and a Problem table is unrelated to PPM Teamspace functionality (it belongs to ITSM). Consequently, only the Demand table and Project table are unique to each teamspace.

**Learn more:** [SPM Teamspace Recommendations and Limitations - ServiceNow Community](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/spm-teamspace-recommendations-and-limitations/ta-p/2299122)

questions.question: The Project management application supports two kinds of external dependencies. What are they? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Project management supports hard and soft external dependencies. A hard dependency automatically propagates predecessor-project changes to the successor project, whereas a soft dependency notifies the successor project manager, who can accept or reject the changes.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Types of external dependencies](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/external-dependency-types.html)

questions.question: In Project Portfolio Management, which role includes both the resource_user role and the it_demand_manager role?
questions.explanation:
The it_project_manager role in ServiceNow's Project Portfolio Management application is configured with a 'Contains Roles' relationship that includes both resource_user and it_demand_manager, along with other roles such as it_project_user. This design grants project managers broad access—covering resource planning/allocation (resource_user) and full demand creation/tracking capabilities (it_demand_manager)—without needing to assign those roles individually.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow PPM - Roles Flashcards | Quizlet](https://quizlet.com/360823763/servicenow-ppm-roles-flash-cards/) · [All IT Project Managers are Demand Managers - ServiceNow Community](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/all-it-project-managers-are-demand-managers/m-p/2989112)

questions.question: Which role should be assigned to users such as portfolio or product managers so that they can create, update, and delete portfolio plans?
questions.explanation:
The Portfolio Planning user role, `sn_align_core.apw_user`, is intended for portfolio managers, product managers, business-unit leads, and similar planning personas. It grants permission to create, update, and delete portfolio plans, as well as free-form roadmaps and planning items.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/installed-with-portfolio-planning.html)

questions.question: Which actions can a project manager take for Agile projects from the **Details** page in Project Workspace? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
The Details page supports Agile project management by allowing an Agile phase to be created and stories to be created or added. It also allows epics associated with the project to be removed. The WBS, widgets and reports, and project Docs belong to separate workspace views or features. ServiceNow documents the Details-page support for creating Agile phases and creating or adding stories.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Project Workspace release notes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/delta-washingtondc-yokohama/yokohama-washingtondc-projectworkspace-release-notes.html) · [ServiceNow: Create and manage agile projects](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/c_CreateAndManageAgileProjects.html)

questions.question: What is used to calculate labor cost when a project or demand has no associated rate model?
questions.explanation:
When no rate model is associated with a project or demand, ServiceNow derives the hourly rate used for labor cost from the default labor rate. [ServiceNow Rate Models](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/rate-model/rate-model.html?contentId=1Q8g94GkRWAsfVFbJDEUDQ)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Rate Models](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/rate-model/rate-model.html?contentId=1Q8g94GkRWAsfVFbJDEUDQ)

questions.question: Which role grants the ability to allocate a resource?
questions.explanation: The resource_manager role in ServiceNow Resource Management is specifically designed to allow users to allocate resources to projects and tasks, manage allocation records, and oversee resource planning. This role has elevated permissions beyond those of resource_user, business_stakeholder, or it_project_user, which are focused on requesting, viewing, or participating in resource-related activities rather than performing the allocation itself.

questions.question: Which role must users have to be considered for resource planning?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Resource Management, the PPS Resource (`pps_resource`) role marks users or groups as eligible resources. Only users with this role are considered in resource planning and can appear in resource plans.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Roles installed with PPM Standard](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/ppm-collaboration/roles-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: Which out-of-the-box planning attributes are enabled by default for attribute-based resource mapping?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow enables Group, Role, and Skill as the default planning attributes for Resource Management, where they are used to map and assign resources by matching their attributes. Employee Type and Expense Type support financial and labor-cost planning.

**Learn more:** [Using the Planning attributes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/planning-attributes.html)

questions.question: Where can a project manager view quick reports of time-card exceptions and category-wise time reported for their projects?
questions.explanation:
Analytics Project manager provides project managers with reports on time-card exceptions and time reported by project time category for the projects they manage.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Analytics Project manager](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/time-card-management/project-manager-dashboard.html)

questions.question: Resource plan costs are categorized into: **(select 3)**
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Resource Management tracks resource plan costs as planned cost, allocated cost, and actual cost. Planned cost reflects the plan, allocated cost reflects allocated work, and actual cost reflects work performed. [ServiceNow: Resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/resource-management/c_ResourcePlans.html?contentId=Y_Y9xRLojOKh7MPQrJqbTw)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/resource-management/c_ResourcePlans.html?contentId=Y_Y9xRLojOKh7MPQrJqbTw)

questions.question: What is the initial step in the process of configuring Portfolio Planning to work with ServiceNow® Project Portfolio Management?
questions.explanation:
The configuration workflow begins by creating an alignment integration. That integration establishes the connection between Portfolio Planning and Project Portfolio Management before default or custom mapping configurations are generated.

**Learn more:** [Configuring Portfolio Planning with PPM](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/configuring-portfolio-planning-with-ppm.html?contentId=zy~P0~aWBY1R9th~j~UNTQ)

questions.question: What provides a centralized view of resource allocations and resource requests?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Resource Management Workspace creates dedicated resource-board views that show current resource allocations and resource requests across resources and work, providing an overall centralized work view.

**Learn more:** [Using Resource Management Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/using-rmw.html?contentId=GekWxUo5OoFLw~7Lr1J3CQ) · [Resource Management Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-mgmt-wrkspc.html)

questions.question: How many WBS levels can be displayed in the planning console?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow’s Planning Console supports the project’s WBS hierarchy rather than restricting the display to a fixed number of levels. Its hierarchy controls allow project tasks to be organized and viewed at all available nested levels, so there is no set WBS-level limit.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Planning console tasks](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/r_PlanningConsoleTasks.html)

questions.question: Which users can access the Project Administration application? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
The `it_pps_admin` role is required for Project Administration settings and configuration tasks. The `admin` role provides access to all ServiceNow features and capabilities, including Project Administration.

**Learn more:** [Create a cost type definition](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAResourceTypeDefinition.html?contentId=TmcD2FR3bxCbxzfXPC91dw) · [Base system roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/user-administration/r_BaseSystemRoles.html)

questions.question: How can the most recent financial forecasts—actuals or planned costs—be compared month over month with the original planned costs in the new Project Workspace?

options.label: A
options.text: Using the Cost plan breakdown form

questions.explanation:
Financial baselines capture planned costs at specific points in time. The baseline comparison capability compares selected financial baselines and supports a monthly view, enabling comparison of the latest actual or planned costs against the initial planned costs.

**Learn more:** [Financials in Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/financial-planning-in-pw.html) · [Compare financial baselines of a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/compare-baselines-of-project.html)

questions.question: Which minimum role is necessary to assign a time sheet policy to a user?

options.label: C
options.text: It is not possible to assign a time sheet policy to a user.

questions.explanation:
Assigning a time sheet policy to a user requires the `timecard_admin` role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Assign a time sheet policy to a user](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/time-card-management/assign-time-sheet-policy-to-user.html)

questions.question: Which resource-related tasks can be completed in Project Workspace? (select 2)

options.label: B
options.text: Allocate a resource creating a named-resource assignment

options.label: E
options.text: Request a resource using role, group, or skill

questions.explanation:
Project Workspace lets a resource requester check resource availability and create resource requests or plans using attributes such as roles, groups, and skills. Its resource-allocation heatmap also displays resource availability and remaining capacity. Resource calendars and request-management functions belong to other administrative or resource-management experiences.

**Learn more:** [Plan resources](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/project-workspace/use-resource-mgmt-prj-wksp.html) · [Create and manage resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/manage-resources-for-project.html?contentId=46EU8YiXD~dMllf~LYuKFg)

questions.question: Which demand category should a demand manager select when they need to create an enhancement?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Demand Management, **Enhancement** is a demand type available under the **Strategic** category. The Operational category instead supports types such as Change and Defect.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Demand form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/4~5Anqt12idfVzJWPcxoHw/OsiYchuOULJFDI4HRnJz0g)

questions.question: A customer needs five (5) teamspaces to support distinct departments. What should you do?

options.label: A
options.text: Contact the Account Representative to activate the teamspaces.

options.label: C
options.text: Use UI Policies and Business Rules to enable teamspaces.

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Teamspaces are enabled by activating their individual Project Management TeamSpace plugins. Five plugins are available—TeamSpace 1 through TeamSpace 5—so enabling all five provides five separate teamspaces.

**Learn more:** [Activate teamspaces](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_ActivateTeamspaces.html?contentId=CZXKDYKlMvV3OUgB6JdBRQ)

questions.question: In which area is the normalization process applied?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow's Smart Assessment Engine (used in GRC) applies normalization during assessment scoring so that scores captured at the question, subsection, section, and overall assessment level—potentially using different scales or weights—can be converted to a consistent, comparable scale. This ensures fair comparison of scores across different assessments, which is why normalization is used specifically in assessment scoring rather than in cost plan updates, risk records, or demand approval processes.

**Learn more:** [Normalization in assessment - ServiceNow Docs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/governance-risk-compliance/smart-assessment-engine/normalization-in-assessment.html)

questions.question: Using the **Request type** field in a resource plan, which options can be used to request a resource? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
A resource plan can request work in person days, hours, or full-time equivalents (FTE). These are the supported Request type options; day and month are not request types.

**Learn more:** [Resource plans](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/c_ResourcePlans.html) · [Extend resource plan form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/extnd-rsrc-plan.html?contentId=XTKBxFkz1R9i7HRrzaEaLA)

questions.question: Which action can a resource manager take to assist with monitoring projects and work items?

options.label: C
options.text: Create resource cards filtered by work type

questions.explanation:
Resource cards can be filtered by work type to display resources working on demands, projects, or epics and their associated details, providing a focused view for monitoring work.

**Learn more:** [Create a resource card](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/rmw-create-rsrc-card.html)

questions.question: Which field must be filled in to request a person in a particular role when creating a resource assignment?
questions.explanation: The Role field specifies the required role for the resource assignment, enabling the request to be fulfilled by a person who has that role.

questions.question: Which features are absent from a teamspace application but can be added through teamspace settings? (select 2)
questions.explanation: A Strategic Portfolio Management teamspace is scoped by default to core agile delivery artifacts, and features tied to upstream portfolio processes - capturing Ideas and running Demand Assessments - are not present until an administrator enables them through the teamspace's settings, at which point they surface as additional tabs/apps inside that teamspace for the team to use.

questions.question: As a demand manager, you can view an artifact associated with a demand. Which artifacts are included in a demand?
questions.explanation:
Demand artifacts include decision, risk, and requirement records. Decisions document demand-related choices, risks track potential impacts to the demand, and requirements capture what must be fulfilled.

**Learn more:** [Add risks for a demand](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/demand-management/add-risks-for-demand.html) · [Add and manage requirements](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/strategic-planning/add-and-manage-requirements-dw.html?contentId=Ay~GJ8IVqi6Aq6VMbJR2bg)

questions.question: What must an administrator configure so that departments with no planning items appear when switching to the Prioritization Hierarchy view?

options.label: A
options.text: Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_show_higher_planning_upper_entities' system property and set it to false

options.label: B
options.text: Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_hide_empty_entities' system property and set It to true

options.label: C
options.text: Create the 'sn_align ws,gantt_hide_empty_entities' system property and set it to false

options.label: D
options.text: Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_show_higher_planning_upper_entities' system property and set it to true

questions.explanation:
Empty parent entities are hidden by default in the Prioritization Hierarchy. Setting the `sn_align_ws.gantt_hide_empty_entities` system property to `false` displays departments that have no associated planning items.

**Learn more:** [Hierarchy view display configuration in Strategic Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/ie86_vHMTYpwOslR6u~tCw/gbtHI2jVeqjg~~z~ktAdsQ)

questions.question: As an it_pps_admin, which tool can be used to detect corrupt data in a project — for example, tasks that have invalid parents or cyclic relations within the project?
questions.explanation: Project Diagnostics is the SAP tool designed to check the consistency of project data, identifying structural issues such as tasks with invalid parent assignments or cyclic relationships in the project hierarchy or network. This tool is used by administrators (such as the it_pps_admin role) to validate and repair project data integrity, which is distinct from Analytics Diagnostics (used for BI reporting data), System Diagnostics (general system/technical health checks), and Edge Encryption Diagnostics (used for data encryption at the network edge).

questions.question: At a minimum, which role is needed to update a project task in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation:
The `it_project_user` role is sufficient to update a project task in Project Workspace; `it_project_manager` can also perform the action but grants broader privileges. ServiceNow lists both roles for updating project tasks.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Update a project task from Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/update-project-task-from-project-workspace.html)

questions.question: Which statement describes the Project Workspace?

options.label: A
options.text: A central location to view of all projects in a portfolio to prioritize work

options.label: B
options.text: A central location for creating and managing projects

options.label: C
options.text: A central location for viewing and assessing business demands

options.label: D
options.text: A central location transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Project Workspace centralizes project management in one place, allowing project managers to create, plan, and manage projects along with related tasks, resources, and financials.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Exploring Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/exploring-project-workspace.html) · [ServiceNow: Create a project from Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/create-project-from-project-workspace.html)

questions.question: Which table should an administrator modify to add extra columns to the side panel or remove default column choices on the Prioritization page in the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation:
Additional or removed Prioritization side-panel column choices are controlled through the list-layout configuration for planning item types. For portfolio plans with multiple associated item types, this configuration is updated on the Planning Item table, `sn_align_core_planning_item`.

**Learn more:** [Configuring additional columns for Prioritization page in Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/pt-BR/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/customizing-the-columns-for-prioritization-page-in-portfolio-planning.html?contentId=rl55rBPJ_1HMHhnAcz2OCA) · [Components installed with Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/installed-with-portfolio-planning.html)

questions.question: On the Demand form’s **Preferences** tab, you have the option to: (select 2)
