options.label: A
options.text: Close a demand on creation of a project

options.label: C
options.text: Close a demand on closure of a project

questions.explanation:
For Project-type demands, the **Close Demand** preference can automatically close the demand either when the project is created or when the project created from the demand is closed. Financial benefits and risk scores are managed elsewhere on the Demand form, not through this preference.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Demand form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/demand-form.html?contentId=MKtkZXcmffyex4BeHzzQAQ)

questions.question: Project score is computed from the individual scores of the following attributes: *(select 2)*
questions.explanation: A project’s overall score incorporates its Value Score and Risk Score (along with Size Score, which is not listed). Value reflects the project’s planned ROI, while risk reflects the project’s risk level.

questions.question: Which role is able to create or modify a rate model?
questions.explanation:
The ServiceNow PPS admin role (`it_pps_admin`) includes the rate model administrator role, which has privileges to manage rate models and rate lines, including their administration and configuration.

**Learn more:** [Roles installed with PPM Standard (Project Portfolio Management)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-it-business-management/page/product/project-portfolio-suite-with-financials/reference/roles-installed-with-PPS-finance.html)

questions.question: When adding a user to which registry must the combination of the user and assigned portfolio be unique?
questions.explanation:
The Stakeholder Registry records users in relation to their assigned portfolios. Its user and portfolio association must be unique to prevent duplicate stakeholder entries for the same user within the same portfolio.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Stakeholder register form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/stakeholder-register-form-ppw.html)

questions.question: Which activities can users assigned the Business stakeholder [business_stakeholder] role carry out? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Can view generated resource capacity for planning items in the Capacity Planning screen.

options.label: B
options.text: Can access all the modules in the Portfolio Planning application.

options.label: C
options.text: Add notes or comments to roadmaps that are shared with them.

options.label: D
options.text: View portfolio plans, free-form roadmaps, and attachments added to the roadmaps.

questions.explanation:
The Business stakeholder role includes read access to generated resource capacity in Capacity Planning and inherits read-only access for portfolio plans and free-form roadmaps shared with the user, including the ability to add notes, comments, and attachments. The role explicitly cannot create or edit roadmap items; unrestricted access to all Portfolio Planning modules belongs to the Portfolio Planning admin role.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with Portfolio Planning](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-planning/installed-with-portfolio-planning.html?contentId=J1cb6PiPnpVMuKgI56ysjw)

questions.question: Which related lists should be primarily used to record financial data for a project? (select 2)
questions.explanation: Cost Plans capture project costs, and Monetary Benefit Plans capture the project’s financial benefits. Together, they are the primary project related lists for financial data.

questions.question: Which formula is used to calculate the risk rank for a risk?
questions.explanation: A risk rank is calculated by multiplying the probability that the risk will occur by the impact it would have if it occurs.

questions.question: Which role can configure an Idea module, map idea categories to the Idea module, and add navigation for the Idea Portal?
questions.explanation:
The `idea_admin` role administers Idea Portal configuration, including configuring Idea modules, mapping idea categories to a module, and adding portal navigation.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Idea Portal administration](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-portal-administration.html) · [ServiceNow: Idea Portal navigation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/innovation-management/idea-portal-navigation.html)

questions.question: Which allocation types are available under the **Allocation Config** tab on a resource plan? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow resource plans support allocation records distributed weekly, monthly, or across the entire plan duration. These allocation types determine how planned hours are distributed through the resource plan period.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource Plan form tabs](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-plan-form-tabs.html?contentId=rWlH0aMu5jAq0duQvBeu9Q)

questions.question: What is the default offset duration used to automatically determine the red/yellow/green task status?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Project Management, automatic task-status calculation uses a default offset of 3 working days. Tasks approaching their planned end date within that threshold become yellow, while tasks past the applicable threshold become red.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Project task form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/project-task-form.html)

questions.question: Which capability enables users to view variances in a project’s schedule?
questions.explanation: Comparing baselines shows how the current schedule differs from the saved baseline, allowing schedule variances to be viewed.

questions.question: What can be used to derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates to calculate planned and actual resource costs for a project or demand?
questions.explanation:
A rate model derives date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for planned and actual resource costs on projects or demands. Its rate lines can apply different rates by date range and matching criteria such as project, demand, user, or role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Rate Models](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/rate-model/rate-model.html)

questions.question: The Program Management application offers the following capabilities to the program manager: (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Create tasks specific to the program.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a program by adding related projects and demands.

options.label: E
options.text: Manage ideas specific to the program.

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Program Management lets a program manager create a program from related projects and demands, create tasks that are specific to the program, and monitor the program’s costs along with resources and schedules. Release creation for sprints and idea management are not Program Management capabilities. [ServiceNow Program Management documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Program Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

questions.question: Which work artifacts may be used to define the scope of a release? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Release Management v2 defines release scope by associating delivery work artifacts such as projects, enhancements, and defects with the release. A portfolio is a higher-level organizational construct, and a demand is evaluated and promoted into an artifact such as a project, enhancement, or defect before it represents delivery work in the release scope.

**Learn more:** [Using Release Management v2](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-service-management/release-management/c_Release.html?contentId=rR5z~YJA36oAcz8jFQf3tg)

questions.question: Which of the following describes a parent-child relationship? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: A parent-child task must finish before another begins.

options.label: B
options.text: Parent-child task relationships do not have any effect on task time constraints.

options.label: C
options.text: Any number of child tasks can be nested under a parent task with or without any dependencies.

options.label: D
options.text: A parent-child relationship is not saved as a record in any table.

questions.explanation:
A parent-child relationship organizes subtasks beneath a parent task and is distinct from a dependency. Any number of child tasks may be nested under a parent, with or without dependencies. The relationship is represented by the Parent field on the child task record rather than by a separate relationship record in a table.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Basics of Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/c_ProjectTasks.html)

questions.question: A project expense line is a cost tied to a particular source. Examples of such specific sources include: (select 3)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow identifies users, fixed assets, and configuration items as source records for project expense lines. Projects and demands can be associated with or receive expense-line costs, but they are not listed as source-record examples for this definition. [Create an expense line](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAExpenseLine.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create an expense line](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/t_CreateAExpenseLine.html)

questions.question: Which options are offered in the **Effort type** field on the Resource Assignments form when requesting resources? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
On the ServiceNow Resource Assignment form, effort can be requested in Hours, FTE (full-time equivalent), or Person days. Group is an assignment type rather than an effort type.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource assignment form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/yokohama-it-business-management/page/product/pw-resource-management/reference/pw-resource-assignment-form.html)

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an offset type on a monetary benefit plan?
questions.explanation:
An offset type specifies the date reference for when monetary benefits start being realized. **Start Date** is a supported reference; rate cards, risks, and costs are not offset types.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Monetary Benefit Plan form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/monetary-benefit-plan-form.html)

questions.question: Which feature offers portfolio managers a central place to create and track the roadmap for project and demand execution?
questions.explanation: Portfolio Workbench centralizes portfolio roadmaps so portfolio managers can plan and monitor the execution of related projects and demands.

questions.question: Where can custom risk ranks and value scores—such as High-Medium, Medium-Low, or Absolute-Low—be configured to assess a risk’s impact and probability?
questions.explanation:
The Risk Value Lookup module is used to configure risk ranks and risk values for particular combinations of impact and probability. These configured values determine the resulting risk classification and score.

**Learn more:** [Configure custom Risk rank and Risk value for a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/risk-value-lookup-project.html)

questions.question: When a user creates a new demand through the Demand Workbench, in what state does the system save the record?
questions.explanation:
A demand created from the Demand Workbench is saved in the Qualified state, allowing it to appear in the workbench for evaluation and analysis.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a demand](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/t_CreatingDemands.html?contentId=aHkih7_B9XK_UYcVeq0DCg) · [ServiceNow: Demand workbench list view](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/c_DemandWorkbenchListView.html)

questions.question: Which field, referenced from the cost plan, determines whether a cost plan is classified as Capex or Opex?
A checklist item record includes a name and which other element?
questions.explanation:
By default, a ServiceNow checklist item record has a name and a Boolean **Complete** field. The field is set to true or false to record whether the checklist item has been completed.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Project task checklists](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/it-business-management/project-management/c_project-task-checklists.html?contentId=RhRzGI8tJcCIiwWcoReySA)

questions.question: When a user's schedule is changed, what action must be performed to update that user's existing capacity data?

options.label: A
options.text: Update calendar manually to reflect the changed capacity

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Resource Management, a user's capacity is derived from their assigned schedule (e.g., working days and hours per day), and this capacity is stored in the Resource Aggregates Daily, Weekly, and Monthly tables. Simply changing the schedule record does not automatically recalculate these stored aggregates. The 'Update Resource Capacity' UI action must be run (either from the user's profile or the Resource Allocation Workbench) to trigger the schedule job that recalculates and updates the resource's capacity data to reflect the new schedule.

**Learn more:** [Resource Capacity in Resource Management - ServiceNow Community](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/resource-capacity-in-resource-management/ta-p/2300141) · [What is the difference between 'Update Resource Capacity' & 'Update Resource Aggregates' UI Action in Resource Management?](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-forum/what-is-the-difference-between-update-resource-capacity-update/m-p/969730)

questions.question: Which UI actions can be used to link RIDAC records? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
RIDAC records can be linked by converting a record into another RIDAC record in the permitted RIDAC sequence or by associating existing RIDAC records with one another. These operations preserve or establish the relationship between risks, issues, decisions, actions, and request changes.

**Learn more:** [Adding RIDAC records for a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-it-business-management/page/product/project-management/concept/ridac-entries-for-project.html)

questions.question: Which activity updates the actuals on a resource plan?
questions.explanation:
Approval of a time card updates the associated resource plan with the time-card hours and the hourly resource rate, producing its actual-hours and actual-cost values.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a time card](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/time-card-management/t_CreateATimeCard.html)

questions.question: In which locations can resource assignments be created? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow supports creating and working with resource assignments in both Project Workspace and Resource Management Workspace. Project Workspace lets project managers create assignments for projects or project tasks, while Resource Management Workspace supports direct resource-assignment workflows for resource managers.

**Learn more:** [Create resource assignments using Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/create-resource-assignment-prj-wksp.html?contentId=qgl_l0cSMonVuCWbeQ~g_g) · [Resource management process](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/r_ResourceManagementProcess.html)

questions.question: A customer wants to identify which activity type is linked to time entries recorded against a project, so they can capitalize build tasks. What is the best method to accomplish this?

options.label: A
options.text: Put all capital project tasks in one phase and report from those tasks.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a capital project task flag.

options.label: D
options.text: Leverage project time categories to classify the time.

questions.explanation: Project time categories (activity types) are designed specifically to classify time entries recorded on project tasks. By leveraging these categories, a customer can tag time entries with the appropriate activity type (e.g., build/capitalizable work) and then report on or process those entries for capitalization purposes. This is the standard, purpose-built approach in PSA solutions for distinguishing types of work performed, rather than relying on task grouping, incidents, or non-standard flags.

questions.question: Which resource states are available in the **Resource status** field on the **New Resource Assignment** form? *(select 4)*
questions.explanation:
The Resource status field supports the states Pending, Approved, Unapproved, and Unassigned. Since Unapproved is not among the supplied choices, only Unassigned, Pending, and Approved can be selected from this list.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: New Resource Assignment form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/create-ra-form-rmw.html?contentId=eEvfG7nh56Vjto53mWZA9Q)

questions.question: The Project Management application allows users to create parent-child relationships between tasks and dependencies—such as finish-to-start and finish-to-finish—between tasks. How many relationships can exist between two tasks?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Project Management permits only one relationship between any two tasks. A task pair can therefore have a single parent-child or dependency relationship, not multiple simultaneous relationships.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Basics of Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/c_ProjectTasks.html)

questions.question: Which of the following states are displayed by default in the process-flow indicator at the top of the Demand form? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
The default Demand process-flow indicator presents the main progression stages Draft, Screening, and Approved. A demand can instead be deferred during evaluation, but Deferred is an alternate outcome, not a default indicator stage; Updated is not a Demand state.

**Learn more:** [Explore Demand Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/demand-management/exploring-demand-management.html) · [Demand workflow](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/strategic-planning/demand-process-flow.html)

questions.question: Which role grants edit access, enabling users to generate capacity planning in Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation: The `sn_align_ws.spw_capacity_user` role grants the edit-level access required for capacity planning in Portfolio Planning Workspace. The corresponding `spw_capacity_read` role is limited to viewing, while the financial and core read-only roles do not provide capacity-planning edit privileges.

questions.question: The **Business Unit** field on a Project or Demand form shows values from a particular table. What type of field is it?
questions.explanation: A reference field stores a relationship to a record in another table and displays selectable values from that referenced table.

questions.question: During the allocation process, when named resources are assigned to a plan, from where is the resource cost derived?

options.label: A
options.text: Labor rate card for the user

options.label: C
options.text: Cost specified on the resource allocation

options.label: D
options.text: Labor rate card for the fiscal period

questions.explanation:
The allocated cost for a named resource is calculated using the applicable labor rate card for the relevant fiscal period. ServiceNow derives resource-plan allocation cost from an hourly rate, with the labor rate card supplying that rate when no higher-priority override or rate model applies.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Resource Allocation form](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/it-business-management/resource-management/rsrc-allocation-form.html)

questions.question: Use this table to configure the parameters shown on a project card on the **My Projects Space** page in Project Workspace.
questions.explanation:
The `pm_home_page_config` table configures the display columns shown on project cards in the My Projects Space page of classic Project Workspace.

**Learn more:** [Configure parameters displayed on project cards](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/configure-project-card-parameters.html)

questions.question: Which conditions must be satisfied to change a project’s planned start date? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: project_funding records are selected for execution

options.label: B
options.text: Project actual dates are not populated

options.label: C
options.text: The state of a project is Pending or Open

options.label: D
options.text: The state of the project is Closed Skipped

questions.explanation: A project’s planned start date can be changed only when actual project dates have not been populated and the project is in the Pending or Open state. Closed Skipped projects are not in an editable lifecycle state, and funding-record execution selection is not a prerequisite.

questions.question: Which roles can configure the default columns in the project planning console? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
The `it_pps_admin` role is required to configure planning-console display columns. A platform `admin` can also perform this configuration through its broad administrative privileges. [ServiceNow: Add a custom column to the planning console](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/add-display-column.html?contentId=hvQhLuNGFCjjlMSQCnA7eA)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Add a custom column to the planning console](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/add-display-column.html?contentId=hvQhLuNGFCjjlMSQCnA7eA)

questions.question: If the **Move project for WIP projects** property is enabled, associated project tasks are moved except when they are in which of the following states? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
With the `com.snc.project.move_project.wip` property enabled, ServiceNow moves only project tasks in the Open and Pending states. Tasks in Work in Progress and Closed states are not moved.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html) · [ServiceNow: Change the planned start date of a project](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/it-business-management/project-management/change-planned-start-date-of-project.html)

questions.question: Which offering provides step-by-step delivery guidance, based on real-world experiences and proven leading practices, for carrying out digital transformations using the expertise of thousands of successful implementations?
questions.explanation:
Now Create is ServiceNow’s prescriptive implementation methodology and asset library. It provides role-based, step-by-step delivery guidance derived from proven leading practices and experience across thousands of successful implementations.

**Learn more:** [Implementation Assets on NowCreate](https://www.servicenow.com/community/technology-articles/implementation-assets-on-nowcreate/ta-p/3277264)

questions.question: When a demand is converted to a project, which two fields retain the original start and due date? (select 2)
questions.explanation: $ae

questions.question: Which role is required to group related projects and demands?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Program Management groups related projects and demands within a program, and the required role for managing programs is `it_program_manager`.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Program Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

questions.question: How can project managers be prevented from creating resource assignments that include named resources?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an Access Control List (ACL) rule

options.label: C
options.text: Create a reference qualifier on the 'assigned to' field

options.label: D
options.text: The system automatically does this and can only be disabled by an admin

questions.explanation:
A business rule can enforce a conditional server-side restriction by detecting a project manager’s attempt to create a resource assignment with a named resource and preventing the record from being saved. Project managers are otherwise supported in assigning named resources in ServiceNow Resource Assignments.

**Learn more:** [Resource Assignment Guidance - How to enable and start](https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/resource-assignment-guidance-how-to-enable-and-start/ta-p/2970134)

questions.question: How can a resource manager easily transfer a task from one resource to another? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Use the Split resource assignments feature

options.label: C
options.text: Drag and drop the resource assignment from one resource to a different resource

options.label: D
options.text: Select 'Reassign' from the row context menu on the work item

questions.explanation:
Resource Management Workspace lets resource managers reassign work by dragging and dropping a resource assignment onto another eligible resource or by choosing **Reassign** from the assigned work item's row context menu. The resources must have matching primary attributes, and reassignment is limited to periods without captured actual hours.

**Learn more:** [Reassign or unassign work using Resource Management Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/rmw-reassign-unassign-work.html)

questions.question: What must be configured when a customer wants to change the attributes that are copied by **Copy Project** or **Copy Partial Project**?
questions.explanation:
The `com.snc.project.copy.additional_attributes` system property defines the additional, comma-separated project-task attributes copied beyond the default fields during project and partial-project copy operations.

**Learn more:** [Properties installed with Project Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/project-management/r_InstalledWithProjectManagement.html)

questions.question: If a resource plan is not manually associated with a time card, it is auto-associated. Which item in the time card is used for this auto-association?
questions.explanation:
Automatic resource-plan association is based on the Task selected in the time card. A plan must contain hard allocations for the user to be associated, but allocation type does not determine the automatic match.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Associate a time card with a resource plan](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-it-business-management/page/product/resource-management/task/t_AssocATimeCardWithAResourcePlan.html)

questions.question: Which roles are able to add stakeholders to a Portfolio? (select 2)
questions.explanation: $af

questions.question: What is the formula used to calculate Forecasted Utilization?
questions.explanation: Forecasted utilization accounts for work that is both allocated and confirmed, measured against total capacity. Its formula is `(Allocated Hours + Confirmed Hours) / Capacity`.

questions.question: Which artifacts can be linked to a program, a portfolio, both, or neither? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, programs group related projects and demands, and portfolios can contain projects and demands. Therefore, both artifact types can be independently associated with a program, a portfolio, both, or neither.

**Learn more:** [Create a program to manage projects and demands](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/t_CreateAProgram.html) · [Create a portfolio](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/portfolio-management/t_CreateAPortfolio.html)

questions.question: Which role is needed to view a project's **Details** tab in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation:
The `it_project_user` role is required to access the Details tab, which displays the project form for the selected project in Project Workspace.

**Learn more:** [Define a project in classic Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-workspace/define-project-in-project-workspace.html?contentId=rteZAvQzTUAGjH7PGXGu8g)

questions.question: Can an `it_project_manager` change a task into a milestone?

options.label: A
options.text: No, this can only be done by a system admin.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console.

options.label: C
options.text: No, the PPS admin role is also required.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes, if the task is assigned to the project manager.

questions.explanation:
An `it_project_manager` can convert an eligible task to a milestone in the Planning Console by right-clicking the task and selecting **Convert to milestone**. The task must not be in Work in Progress and must not be a parent task.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Planning console tasks](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/project-management/r_PlanningConsoleTasks.html)

questions.question: Which characteristics describe the default Resource Management schedule? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
The default Resource Management Schedule runs weekly on weekdays, with two Monday-through-Friday work periods: 08:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00. It is not the separate “8-5 weekdays excluding holidays” schedule and does not run on Saturday.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Resource schedules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/resource-management/c_UsingResourceSchedules.html?contentId=dT8~TicbtQvkHQ4qVxahVA)

questions.question: When creating a program, which of the following cannot belong to multiple programs? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Program Management, a project or a demand can belong to only one program. A program may be standalone or belong to one portfolio, while program-specific tasks are created to support the program.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Program Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

questions.question: What role should be assigned to a project manager who is responsible for approving time sheets or submitting time cards on behalf of team members?
questions.explanation:
The `timecard_admin` role provides administrative access for time-card management, including approving time sheets or time cards. It is the applicable listed role for a project manager who must act on team members’ time records.

**Learn more:** [Approve or reject a time sheet](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/approve-time-sheet.html) · [Time Card Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/time-card-management.html)

questions.question: Which project attribute is indicated by the color band at the top of a project card in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Project Workspace, a project card’s top color band is based on the project record’s **Status** field. The project state, risks, and issues are displayed separately. 

**Learn more:** [Configure parameters displayed on project cards in classic Project Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/it-business-management/project-workspace/configure-project-card-parameters.html)

questions.question: Risks and issues submitted on which forms are included in the Program record? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
A Program record includes its own risks and issues, along with risks and issues from projects and demands that are part of that program. Portfolios aggregate information above programs, while ideas are not included in this Program Management rollup.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Program Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/program-management/c_ProgramManagement.html)

questions.question: Which feature in Resource Management Workspace provides a breakdown view of assigned work and effort?
questions.explanation:
The allocation heatmap modal provides the breakdown of assigned work and associated effort. It exposes allocation and utilization detail, including task-level efforts, to help resource managers assess resource capacity and assignments.

**Learn more:** [Exploring Resource Management Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/4~5Anqt12idfVzJWPcxoHw/jXuyhP0aImfhpq0bp42Zwg?section=explore-rmw__section_kz2_fml_bjc)

questions.question: Rather than building a project plan from the ground up, what can project managers leverage to quickly create their project plan?
questions.explanation: Project templates provide a pre-defined set of tasks, milestones, durations, and resource assignments typical for a given project type. By starting a new project from a template, a project manager can rapidly generate a full plan structure instead of manually entering every task and dependency, significantly speeding up project setup.
